name: pr-reviewer
description: Repo-level tooling (lint, format, git hooks) and shortcuts for the backend/ and frontend/ packages.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['backend/node_modules','backend/dist','frontend/node_modules','frontend/dist']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
